blockers.title: Raw Markdown asterisks and 18-line unclipped keyWordMeaning in ElianaVerseTiers make a single verse card overflow the screen in Study mode
Deeper chip in VerseActionBar is a dead no-op in Study mode and collides with adjacent Deeper insight chip
Missing Loading/Offline states for elianaEntries flashes false 'awaiting its Eliana rendering' card on chapter load and misleads offline users
firestore.rules still permits any non-anonymous authenticated user to overwrite canonical verse_insights documents

findings.title: Raw Markdown asterisks and 18-line unclipped keyWordMeaning overflow the viewport
Deeper chip is a no-op in Study mode and collides with Deeper insight
Missing Loading/Offline state flashes ElianaChapterInviteCard and falsely claims verses are not yet in the Eliana Bible when offline
verse_insights collection allows unconstrained writes/overwrites by any signed-in Google user
Written study duplicates tier card opening sections in degraded LTR sans-serif font and exposes 'Eliana pipeline' label
Duplicate chapter Firestore reads on ELIANA version, full-chapter Firestore read on single-verse Compare, and per-verse N+1 Room queries in ElianaVerseTiers
Unlabeled download icon runs 2xN sequential network requests per chapter and caches only 1 fuzzy word study per verse
Zero visual affordance on tappable Hebrew/Greek/transliterated tokens and Tier 4 study doorway; Aleph glyph used on Greek NT
Chapter swipe dead-ends at book boundaries, conflicts with SelectionContainer, and lacks BackHandler for selection/search/immersive
3-row static header consumes ~180dp and places per-verse Compare modal action inside the chapter mode switcher
Tiers 1, 2, and 4 ignore fontSizeSp scaling; Thompson chain badge is below 48dp touch target; ContinuousChapterPage merges up to 50 verses into one TalkBack node
SacredLinen primary orange accent clashes with warm linen palette and multi-verse selection hides depth chips without explanation

upgrades.name: Parse Markdown emphasis and cap Tier 4 keyWordMeaning at 3 lines with explicit 'Read full verse study' CTA
upgrades.why: Fixes raw asterisks and full-screen single-verse cards on the primary Study surface

upgrades.name: Unify Deeper and Deeper insight in VerseActionBar and fix Study mode expansion
upgrades.why: Eliminates a broken no-op button and confusing duplicate depth labels

upgrades.name: Lock verse_insights to allow write: if false in firestore.rules
upgrades.why: Prevents any authenticated client from poisoning canonical verse studies in production

upgrades.name: Add Loading/Offline states to elianaEntries and remove ElianaChapterInviteCard
upgrades.why: Stops false 'awaiting rendering' flashes on every chapter change and honest offline messaging

upgrades.name: Render ElianaVerseTiers header in VerseStudyScreen and strip duplicate Scripture/Fresh Rendering markdown sections
upgrades.why: Eliminates verbatim repetition and fixes LTR sans-serif Hebrew rendering on the study screen

upgrades.name: Preload chapter OriginalWordEntity rows in ViewModel and deduplicate Firestore chapter reads
upgrades.why: Removes async layout jumps on scroll and cuts Firestore chapter reads by 50%+

upgrades.name: Add BackHandler, cross-book chapter rollover, and bottom Prev/Next chapter buttons
upgrades.why: Prevents accidental reader exits on Back press and dead-ends at book boundaries

upgrades.name: Bundle 31,069 eliana_bible rows into local Room database asset
upgrades.why: Makes all 4 tiers instant and 100% offline while reducing ongoing Firestore chapter read cost to zero

upgrades.name: Wire ScriptureLinkedText into VerseStudyScreen and WordStudySheet markdown
upgrades.why: Turns cross-references inside verse and word essays into interactive scripture doors

upgrades.name: Parallelize OfflinePackManager.keepChapter with batched queries and clear UI labeling
upgrades.why: Makes offline chapter study caching 10x faster and understandable to users

upgrades.name: ElianaChapterInviteCard progress counter and live chapter rendering prompt
upgrades.why: All 31,069 verses are already complete; the invite card only misfires during loading and offline states

upgrades.name: Separate Deeper and Deeper insight chips in VerseActionBar
upgrades.why: Two similarly named depth chips in one bar permanently confuse the hierarchy between inline tiers and full essays

upgrades.name: Full-chapter SelectionContainer wrapping the LazyColumn
upgrades.why: Conflicts with horizontal chapter swipe gestures and duplicates the cleaner verse-tap Copy/Share flow
